risk_if_not_implemented: Without Defined Operational Resilience Requirements, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Operational Resilience Capabilities
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to ensure capabilities are implemented to provide operational resilience to:
(1) Unintentional errors; and 
(2) Intentional attack or circumvention.
compensating_control_1.justification: Operational Resilience Capabilities (BCD-03) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Defined Operational Resilience Requirements (BCD-02.1) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct a Business Impact Analysis (BIA) to identify and assess security, compliance and resilience risks.
compensating_control_2.justification: Business Impact Analysis (BIA) (RSK-08) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Defined Operational Resilience Requirements (BCD-02.1) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
